Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with high fever and confusion

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 64-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-08-16.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed high fever and confusion.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Haddad (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
